briefdescription.para: Legacy helper, equivalent to si5332_init(pDev, SI5332_CLK_SRC_XTAL_27M).
Driver for the Skyworks Si5332A-D-GM2 (8 outputs, 40-QFN), fixed VCO at 2.5 GHz, switchable input source (27 MHz crystal / 100 MHz CLKIN_2).

detaileddescription.para:
Concept:
Almost all output registers (OUTx_MODE, OUTx_DIV, ID dividers, input/PLL registers, power-down bits) are only writable in READY mode. Changes are therefore collected in the driver (si5332_set_output_format() / si5332_set_output_freq()) and applied with si5332_commit() in a single READY->ACTIVE cycle.
Every commit briefly interrupts ALL outputs, including OUT6 (25 MHz).
OUT6 (25 MHz CMOS system clock) is fixed and cannot be changed via the API.
HSDIV0 (100 MHz) and HSDIV1 (125 MHz) are fixed; additional frequencies are generated via the two MultiSynths (ID0/ID1, fractional).
